description: This file defines a Presenter class responsible for managing trace log data, applying filters, and updating UI data accordingly in a trace viewer application.

classes.name: Presenter
classes.description: A class that manages trace log data, applies filters, and updates UI data for a trace viewer.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Presenter with trace data and a callback to notify UI updates.

methods.name: onTracePositionUpdate
methods.description: Updates the current trace entry based on a new trace position.

methods.name: onLogLevelsFilterChanged
methods.description: Updates the log level filters and recomputes UI data.

methods.name: onTagsFilterChanged
methods.description: Updates the tag filters and recomputes UI data.

methods.name: onSourceFilesFilterChanged
methods.description: Updates the source file filters and recomputes UI data.

methods.name: onSearchStringFilterChanged
methods.description: Updates the search string filter and recomputes UI data.

methods.name: computeUiDataMessages
methods.description: Filters trace entries based on current filters and updates the UI data.

methods.name: computeUiDataCurrentMessageIndex
methods.description: Calculates the current message index within filtered messages for UI display.

methods.name: getUniqueMessageValues
methods.description: Extracts and sorts unique values for a specified message property.
